Class GeneratedBeanTypeHierarchy

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.inject.beans.GeneratedBeanTypeHierarchy
All Implemented Interfaces:
BeanTypeHierarchy
@Internal public final class GeneratedBeanTypeHierarchy extends Object implements BeanTypeHierarchy
The BeanTypeHierarchy a generated introspection describes: the types as class values, each once, and for each type the indexes of the types it extends and implements itself. The classes are loaded when the types are first asked for.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

  • Constructor Details

    • GeneratedBeanTypeHierarchy

      public GeneratedBeanTypeHierarchy(Class<?> beanType, AnnotationClassValue<?>[] types, int[][] superTypes, int[][] methodLevels, BeanIntrospection<?> introspection)
      The hierarchy as the generated introspection describes it.
      Parameters:
      beanType - The introspected type
      types - The types, each once, the introspected one first
      superTypes - For each type, the indexes into types of the types it extends and implements itself: the super class first, NO_SUPERCLASS for an interface and OBJECT_SUPERCLASS for a class extending Object, then the interfaces
      methodLevels - For each bean method of the introspection, in their order, the indexes into types of its declaring levels: the type declaring it, then the types declaring a method it overrides, nearest first
      introspection - The introspection describing the type

    • getDeclaringTypes

      public List<Class<?>> getDeclaringTypes(BeanMethod<?,?> method)
      Description copied from interface: BeanTypeHierarchy
      The declaring levels of a bean method: the type declaring it, then every type of the hierarchy declaring a method it overrides, each once, nearest first: in the breadth first order of the hierarchy of the introspected type, the super class before the interfaces, so a type the introspected type extends or implements directly comes before a type that one extends or implements in turn. An inherited method overrides the methods of the interfaces the introspected type introduces as well, those are levels too. Class.isInterface() tells which levels are interfaces.
      Specified by:
      getDeclaringTypes in interface BeanTypeHierarchy
      Parameters:
      method - A bean method instance of the introspection, compared by identity
      Returns:
      The declaring types, empty for a method that is not a bean method of the introspection
